Join over 10 million users! Become a better sleeper and morning person thanks to 100 years of sleep science with RISE, the only sleep tracker that also measures your sleep debt and energy levels.

But RISE is more than a sleep and energy tracker. Users can access widgets, calendar integration, sleeping sounds, meditation guides, smart alarm clocks, habit reminders, and a sleep knowledge library.

FROM THE RISE COMMUNITY

***
Chase M.
"RISE helped me understand how vital sleep truly is. In only a few weeks, I found myself more focused, energetic, and productive at work."

***
Becky G.
"I could see where sleep debt was causing issues, like temper short, not comprehending things, moving slowly.  I had an epiphany... I'm getting 45min more sleep on average than I was before RISE."


UNLOCK BETTER SLEEP
Tired of the age-old "eight hours of shut-eye" advice? Go beyond buying a new mattress or pillow and discover the life-changing concept of Sleep Debt.

Scientifically proven to be a vital factor in your well-being, a low Sleep Debt can improve your life quality and even your longevity—while high Sleep Debt can cause fatigue and harm your health.

RISE calculates your Sleep Debt, helps you understand its impact on your energy, and guides you on how to lower it by improving sleeping habits. Learn about your melatonin window, when to prioritize sleep, and understand the real cost of those late nights—and how you can benefit from naps.

PERSONALIZED SLEEP TRACKER
Do you find your mind racing when your head hits the pillow? Can’t stop doom-scrolling on your phone? Feeling fatigued all day?

Based on your sleep data, circadian rhythm and research, we’ll make recommendations that fit your needs and guide you toward healthier habits.

RISE will get you in bed on time, guide you when you can’t sleep, reduce the times you wake up at night, and make you feel less groggy in the morning.

DISCOVER YOUR CIRCADIAN RHYTHM
We all have an internal brain clock, our circadian rhythm, it signals to our body when to be alert or go into recovery mode. Everyone is unique, from when we perform our best to when we should sleep and wake up. We use advanced algorithms to find your optimal sleep windows.

You’ll gain insight into your circadian rhythm and energy levels, helping you plan for a productive day.

Sleeping refuels energy, and 83% of RISE users feel more energy in a week or less.

AUTOMATICALLY TRACK SLEEP
Through our integration with Apple Health, Apple Watch, Fitbit, Oura, and data from other sleep trackers on your phone, like Sleep Cycle and ShutEye, RISE can determine the hours of sleep you get every night, sleep debt, the number of steps you take each day, as well as data from other activities that affect your sleep pattern.

WHY WE STARTED RISE
We want to help get ahead of the Insufficient Sleep Epidemic (CDC, 2014) we're experiencing, which has been increasing since 1985. This Epidemic has led to elevated mortality rates (Cappuccio, 2010) as well as underperformance in most aspects of life (RAND, 2016).

Today, we look at sleep as a luxury. RISE strives to create a world where healthy sleep is a necessity.

Your sleep schedule is off. Phase shifts it back — one day at a time.

Phase is a guided program that fixes your broken sleep schedule through small, progressive daily shifts. No vague advice. No endless tracking. Just a clear plan that moves your bedtime and wake time closer to your goal — 15 minutes at a time.

Tell Phase when you currently sleep, when you want to sleep, and it builds a personalized day-by-day plan to get you there.


HOW IT WORKS

- Pick a program that fits your situation
- Set your current and goal sleep times
- Get a personalized day-by-day schedule
- Follow science-backed daily nudges
- Watch your sleep shift into place


6 SLEEP PROGRAMS

Phase is not one-size-fits-all. Pick the program that matches your situation:

- Sleep Schedule Reset — the original 14-day phase shift
- Night Owl Fix — stop going to bed at 3 AM
- Jet Lag Recovery — get back on local time fast
- Weekend Drift Reset — fix the Sunday-night-to-Monday-morning gap
- Shift Work Transition — adjust to a new work schedule
- Early Riser Challenge — become a morning person in two weeks


YOUR DAILY NUDGES

Every day, Phase gives you timed nudges based on your schedule and your local sunrise and sunset:

- Morning Light — get sunlight early to reset your internal clock
- Caffeine Cutoff — stop caffeine at the right time so it does not interfere with sleep
- Screen Dim — reduce blue light before bed to protect melatonin
- Wind Down — start your pre-sleep routine at the right moment
- Bedtime — hit the pillow at your new target time

All nudge times adjust automatically as your schedule shifts forward each day. Toggle nudges on or off and fine-tune timing to fit your life.


WIDGETS AND LIVE ACTIVITY

- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for sun position, nudge checklist, bedtime countdown, and sleep stats
- Bedtime Live Activity — a countdown on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island as bedtime approaches
- Bedtime alarm that rings through Silent Mode and Do Not Disturb


WHAT MAKES PHASE DIFFERENT

- A real program, not a tracker — a clear plan with a finish line
- Location-aware — nudge times sync with your actual sunrise and sunset
- Works offline — no account, no login, no cloud
- Science-backed — based on circadian rhythm research
- Beautiful Sun Arc — a visual map of your day showing light, nudges, and targets
- Schedule exceptions — have an early flight? Adjust one day without breaking your plan
- Takes 30 seconds to set up


TRACK YOUR PROGRESS

See your journey laid out. Check off each day. Build streaks. Get encouragement when you need it. Know exactly how far you have come and how close you are to your goal.


HEALTHKIT INTEGRATION

Phase reads your sleep, sunlight, exercise, and caffeine data from Apple Health to auto-verify nudges and show activity bars on your daily timeline. Phase never writes to HealthKit — your data stays yours.


BUILT FOR FOCUS

No charts. No dashboards. No social features. Phase does one thing and does it well — it fixes your sleep schedule.

Your body has a clock. Phase helps you reset it.

results.description:
NapMap catches the sleepy moment before it slips away.

Log a nap as it happens — one big Start Nap / End Nap button — and NapMap recalculates the rest of the day around it. No spreadsheets, no wake-window math in your head.

WHAT IT DOES
• Age-aware wake windows. NapMap knows your baby's age and uses the right wake windows, lengthening them as your baby grows and giving you a heads-up when they shift. Tell it how many naps a day when you can see one's ready to drop.
• One-thumb logging. A single big button to start and end a nap. Log it in the moment; fix the times later with a tap if needed.
• Built around your wake-up OR bedtime. Anchor the day on the morning wake-up or the bedtime — whichever matters most to your family. The day re-fits after every nap, and NapMap nudges you when an early bedtime and a late wake-up don't line up.
• Night tracking. Walk the night with Awake and Back to Sleep, then see how nights compare to what's typical for your baby's age.
• A weekly map. Every nap and night lands on a simple week-at-a-glance chart, so you can watch naps and bedtime settle into the same times each day and know your hard work is paying off.

IT ADAPTS TO YOUR BABY
Age-based wake windows are averages — your baby isn't. After about two weeks of logged naps, NapMap learns their actual rhythm (their typical wake windows and nap lengths) and tunes the schedule toward it, always staying within age-appropriate bounds. The schedule fits your baby instead of forcing your baby onto a chart.

SHARE THE LOAD
Invite your baby's other caregivers so everyone's looking at the same day. A nap logged by one caregiver shows up for the other.

NUMBERS YOU CAN TRUST
Sleep-duration guidance comes from the American Academy of Sleep Medicine and the National Sleep Foundation. Wake windows are a practical convention, not a clinical rule — and we say so plainly. No black box.

FREE, FOREVER
Every nap app and sleep consultant seemed to want a credit card before offering any real help — comfort tucked behind a paywall, sold to parents on their hardest nights. NapMap is free. Good sleep, for your baby and for you, shouldn't cost anything.

Not medical advice — you know your baby best.

Built with love, for Avery. I hope it gives your family a few easier days and a lot more soft, sleepy nights.

Relax and fall asleep to the sound of your favorite song or one of the preset sleep music.


APP FEATURES:

It has a feature that allows you to listen to sleeping music when you are ready to retire for the night.
Through this feature, users can be smoothly lead off to sleep.


WHY WE DEVELOPED THIS APP:

The planning for this app started when we happened to hear from a nursery school teacher that, "The children always sleep well on rainy days."

Through further investigation, we heard the same thing, not just from other nursery school teachers, but many mothers as well.

But, through what mechanism this was happening by remained unclear. There are various theories, such as an atmospheric pressure theory (it was due to low atmospheric pressure), a light intensity theory (it was due to the sky being dark and cloudy), and a sound theory (it was due to the sound of rain being close to an f/1 tremor).

We decided to focus on the sound theory and added a feature, to a basic alarm clock app that plays sleeping music, such as the sound of rain.

Baby Energy Tracking (Predict Overtiredness Before Meltdowns) 
Cocoo’s Energy Tracker visualizes sleep pressure like a battery. During awake time, energy moves from green (well rested) to yellow (getting tired) to red (overtired). During sleep, the battery recharges from red to yellow to green. Using pediatric sleep science, wake window research, circadian rhythm modeling, and your baby’s real data, Cocoo predicts when overtiredness is building — before meltdowns, short naps, or bedtime resistance begin. Better timing leads to easier naps and smoother nights.

- Frequent night wakings

- Early morning wakings or early rising

Schedules align with American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) sleep duration ranges and World Health Organization (WHO) healthy sleep recommendations. No sudden schedule shifts. Cocoo works with what is happening — helping you improve consistency without overwhelming your baby.

results.description:
An estimated 1 out of 3 adults worldwide struggle with sleep. Their brains find it difficult to shift into a lower gear to reach Theta and Delta brainwaves which are necessary for sleeping.

For centuries it has already been known that sound can change the mental state of the brain. Sound can cause anxiety, it can bring calmness, and it can also affect sleep. There is a solid science behind why this exactly happens, and it all has to do with brainwaves.

Brainwaves are the electrical signals the brain uses to process information, think, and communicate with the body. Brainwaves run at different speeds during different mental states. When we’re in a deep sleep, it predominantly runs at 1 to 4 Hz; when dreaming, it runs at 4 to 8 Hz; when awake, it runs at 8 to 12 Hz, and when highly alert, it runs at 12 to 100Hz.

So how does sound affect brainwaves? Brainwaves are frequencies, and sound is also frequencies. When a person listens to a sound frequency, the brain synchronizes with that frequency. The brain starts pulsing the electrical form of the frequency, brainwaves.

For example, when a person listens to a pulsing sound of 4 beats per second, the brain starts pulsing a 4 Hz Delta brainwave, which is the signal for sleeping.

Scientists have used this technique to help people sleep with some success. It has turned out that the brain resonates well with certain frequencies and not so well with others.

Albert La Grange has spent more than 12 years of research and has done over 6000 sound frequency tests. He discovered the exact sound frequencies that resonate well with the brain and that enable a person to fall asleep.

To share this discovery with others, an app called Evolutioner was created where these frequencies are embedded in ambient and cinematic music sessions. The user simply listens to a 12-minute music session to fall asleep. No other action is needed for it to work.

People can now download the Evolutioner app from the App Store. The app is already being used by more than 50000 people every day and night.

If you have issues with falling and staying asleep, download the Evolutioner app and try it out tonight.

Please note that Evolutioner is not a replacement for medical or psychological treatment and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. We do not express, imply, or intend any medical claims. Although all statements on the website are accompanied by research or user feedback, no statements have been approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

Nighty is a calm sleep cycle calculator to help you time your sleep with ease.
No tracking, no accounts, no setup — just a simple nightly tool that suggests gentle times to sleep or wake.



Two simple modes

Wake-up mode
Know when you need to wake up? Nighty suggests bedtimes aligned with natural sleep cycles.

Bedtime mode
Going to sleep now? Nighty shows wake-up times that land near cycle boundaries.



Built around sleep cycles

Sleep typically occurs in ~90-minute cycles.
Waking near the end of a cycle can feel easier than waking in the middle of deep sleep.

Nighty suggests times based on this model — a helpful guide, not medical advice.



Accounts for sleep latency

The time it takes you to fall asleep (“sleep latency”) is factored into each calculation.

You can adjust this in Settings if you tend to fall asleep faster or slower than average.



Multiple options, clearly presented

Starting from your chosen time, Nighty shows several cycle options so you can decide what works for your night.

Five cycles (~7.5 hours) are gently highlighted by default as a common full-night duration, but you’re free to choose what fits your schedule.



Simple by design

• Instant answers
• No journaling
• No sleep tracking hardware
• No personal data required

Nighty is built around a single purpose: helping you time your sleep.



Private and offline

All calculations happen on-device. No data is collected.
